_help: Skill manifest (source of truth). Copy to skills/<skill-name>/manifest.json and fill in. The 'name' MUST match the folder name. Only register commands that actually exist. 'intents' maps an intent id to trigger phrases. For precise routing, fill in the V2 routing boundaries: use_when (positive triggers), not_when (negative triggers — when this skill should NOT win), objects (things the skill acts on), actions (verbs it applies), conflicts_with (overlapping skills it competes with on the same task).
name: my-skill
description: One or two sentences: what this skill does and when to use it.
